## Task 1 · A racing game on a 6 GB phone (3 marks)

A phone has **6 GB** of RAM. The OS uses **2 GB**. The player races in
*Turbo Lane* (**3 GB**, on the screen). In the background wait a chat app
(**0.6 GB**, used 2 minutes ago) and a video app (**0.8 GB**, used 30 minutes
ago).

a) How much RAM is in use, and is it more than 6 GB? (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

why? (1 mark)
